questions.question:
The given bar chart represents the number of Televisions Sets (TV) manufactured (in thousands) and the respective percentage of those TV Sets sold by five different companies A, B, C, D and E in 2015.

Study the chart carefully and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/817793ee91199a6c3286f502a5cedf7c073946a76cc73c0ac1a5a166bff8cbf5.png] 

The average number of TV sets sold by companies C and D is what percentage of the number of TV sets manufactured by company E? Express your answer correct to one place of decimal.
questions.solution:
Calculation:

TV sets manufactured by company C = 70000

TV sets sold by company C = 82% of 70000 = 57400

TV sets manufactured by company D = 85000

TV sets sold by company D = 56% of 85000 = 47600

Total TV sold by C and D = 57400 + 47600 = 105000

Average TV sold by C and D = 105000/2 = 52500

TV sets manufactured by company E = 58000

Now, % = 52500/58000 × 100% ≈ 90.5%

**∴ The average number of TV sets sold by companies C and D is 90.5% of the number of TV sets manufactured by company E.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper allows a 28% discount on the marked price of an article and still makes a profit of 20%. If he gains ₹30.80 on the sale of one article, then what is the selling price (in ₹) of the article?
questions.solution:
Given:

A shopkeeper allows a 28% discount on the marked price of an article and still makes a profit of 20%.

He gains ₹30.80 on the sale of one article.

Concept used:

Selling price = Marked Price - Marked Price × Discount%

Selling Price = Cost Price + Cost Price × Gain%

Calculation:

Let the marked and cost price of the article be q and p. 

The selling price = q - q × 28% = 0.72q

According to the concept,

0.72q = p + p × 20%

⇒ 0.72q = 1.2p

⇒ 0.6q = p ....(1)

According to the question,

0.72q = p + 30.80

⇒ 0.72q = 0.6q + 30.80 (From 1)

⇒ 0.12q = 30.80

⇒ q = 30.8/0.12

⇒ q = 770/3

Now, the selling price = 0.72 × 770/3 = ₹184.80

∴ The selling price of the article is ₹184.80.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Let the Marked price be Rs. 100

He gives 28% discount,

⇒ SP = 100 × (100 - 28)% = 100 × 72% = 72

He gains 20% on 72

CP = 72 × 100/120 = 72 × 5/6 = 60

According to the question, 

⇒ 72 - 60 = 12 = 30.80

SP = 72 = 12 × 6

⇒ SP = 30.80 × 6 = 184.80

∴ The selling price of the article is ₹184.80.

questions.question: The difference between compound interest compounded annually and simple interest on a certain sum at a rate of 15% per annum for 2 years is ₹1,944. Find the compound interest compounded annually (in ₹) on the same sum for the same period at a rate of 10% per annum.
questions.solution:
Given:

The difference between compound interest compounded annually and simple interest on a certain sum at a rate of 15% per annum for 2 years is ₹1,944.

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

In case of the compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the principal amount be P.

According to the question,

P(1 + 15/100)² - P = (P × 15 × 2)/100 + 1944

⇒ 1.3225P - P = 0.3P + 1944

⇒ 0.3225P - 0.3P = 1944

⇒ 0.0225P = 1944

⇒ P = 1944/0.0225

⇒ P = 86400

Now, the compound interest incurred on the same sum for the same period at a rate of 10% per annum

⇒ 86400(1 + 10/100)² - 86400

⇒ 104544 - 86400 = ₹18144

**∴ The compound interest compounded annually (in ₹) on the same sum for the same period at a rate of 10% per annum is ₹18,144.**

questions.question: Ram travelled from a place Z to P at an average speed of 130 km/h. He travelled the first 75% of the distance in two-third of the time and the rest at an average speed of X kmh. The value of (x)/(2) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average speed = 130 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × time

**Calculation:**

Let the distance be y km

Time is taken by him = y/130 h

75% of the distance = 75% of y = (3/4)y

Time is taken by him to complete the distance of y km = (y/130) × (2/3) = y/195

Rest distance = y - (3y/4) = y/4

Time taken by him = (y/130) - (y/195) = y/390

Now,

According to the question,

X = (y/4)/(y/390)

⇒ X = 390/4 km

⇒ X = 97.5 km

So, x/2 = 97.5/2

⇒ 48.75

**∴ The value of (x)/(2) is 48.75.**

questions.question: What is the least square number which is exactly divisible by 2, 3, 10, 18 and 20?
questions.solution:
Given:

2, 3, 10, 18 and 20

Concept used:

LCM is the smallest common multiple of two or more numbers.

Calculation:

The least or smallest number which is exactly divisible by 2, 3, 10, 18, and 20 is the LCM of 2, 3, 10, 18, and 20. 

LCM (2, 3, 10, 18, 20) = 180

180 = 2² × 3² × 5

So, to become a perfect square 180 needs to be multiplied by 5. 

Now, the least square number which is exactly divisible by 2, 3, 10, 18 and 20

⇒ 180 × 5 = 900

**∴ The least-square number which is exactly divisible by 2, 3, 10, 18, and 20 is 900.**

questions.question: 80% and 90% pure acid solutions are mixed to obtain 20 litres of 87% pure acid solution. Find the quantity (in litres) of 80% pure acid solution taken to form the mixture.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

80% and 90% pure acid solutions are mixed to obtain 20 litres of 87% pure acid solution.

**Calculation:**

Let x litres and y litres be respectively the amount of 80% and 90% pure acid solutions. 

As per the given condition,

0.80x + 0.90y = 20 × 0.87

⇒ 0.80x + 0.90y = 20 × 0.87 ----(i) 

And x + y = 20 ----(ii)

From (ii), substituting y = 20 – x in (i) we get 

0.80x + 0.90(20 – x) = 20 × 0.87

⇒ 0.80x + 0.90 × 20 – 0.90x = 20 × 0.87 

⇒ 0.10x = 0.90 × 20 – 20 × 0.87

⇒ 0.10x = 18 - 17.4

⇒ 0.10x = 0.6

⇒ x = 6

So, The quantity of 80% pure acid solution is 6 liters

**∴ The quantity (in litres) of 80% pure acid solution taken to form the mixture is 6 liters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**With the help of alligetaion method

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc9b3df3b8335e66560c9b9e7ea719576e232c9e4a015a577fa602e274d1411f.png] 

So, ratio of quantity of 80% and 90% pure acid in the solution = 3 : 7

So, 80% pure acid = 20 × (3/10)

⇒ 6 liters.

questions.question: In a circle with centre O, PA and PB are tangents to the circle at point A and point B, respectively. C is a point on the major arc AB. If ∠ACB = 50°, then find the measure of ∠APB.
questions.solution:
Given:

In a circle with centre O, PA and PB are tangents to the circle at point A and point B, respectively. C is a point on the major arc AB.

∠ACB = 50°

Concept used:

The angle subtended by an arc of a circle at its centre is twice the angle subtended by it at any point of the alternate segment of the circle.

The Sum of all internal angles of a quadrilateral is 360°.

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f60bab58ee0578b7110c56597fe0f49ef282e462f61bb160c6ff2402caa1a444.png] 

According to the concept,

∠AOB = 2 × ∠ACB

⇒ ∠AOB = 2 × 50°

⇒ ∠AOB = 100°

Consider the quadrilateral AOBP, 

∠A + ∠O + ∠B + ∠P = 360°

⇒ 90° + 100° + 90° + ∠P = 360°

⇒ ∠P = 360° - 90° - 90° - 100°

⇒ ∠P = 80°

⇒ ∠APB = 80°

**∴ The measure of ∠APB is 80°.**

questions.question: A college hostel mess has provisions for 25 days for 350 boys. At the end of 10 days, when some boys were shifted to another hostel, it was found that now the provisions will last for 21 more days. How may boys were shifted to another hostel?
questions.solution:
Given:

A college hostel mess has provisions for 25 days for 350 boys.

At the end of 10 days, when some boys were shifted to another hostel, it was found that now the provisions will last for 21 more days.

Concept used:

Available provisions = Number of days × Number of boys

Calculation:

Available provisions = 25 × 350 = 8750 units

After 10 days the remaining provision = 8750 - 10 × 350

⇒ 5250 units

Let N number of boys shifted to another hostel.

According to the question,

(350 - N) × 21 = 5250

⇒ 350 - N = 5250/21

⇒ 350 - N = 250

⇒ N = 350 - 250

⇒ N = 100

∴ 100 boys were shifted to another hostel.

questions.question: Points A and B are on a circle with centre O. PA and PB are tangents to the circle from an external point P. If PA and PB are inclined to each other at 42°, then find the measure of ∠OAB.
questions.solution:
Given:

Points A and B are on a circle with centre O. PA and PB are tangents to the circle from an external point P. 

PA and PB are inclined to each other at 42°.

Concept used:

Sum of all internal angles of a triangle is 180°.

Sum of all internal angles of a quadrilateral is 360°.

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b7c326eb064d7ac04f255bba32a38b8155632e448bed451ed4e03547a011860.png] 

Consider the quadrilateral AOBP, 

∠A + ∠O + ∠B + ∠P = 360°

⇒ 90° + ∠O + 90° + 42° = 360°

⇒ ∠O = 360° - 90° - 90° - 42°

⇒ ∠O = 138°

ΔOAB is an isosceles triangle since OA and OB are the radii of the circle.

So, ∠OAB = ∠OBA = R° (let)

2R° + 138° = 180° 

⇒ 2R° = 42° 

⇒ R = 21° 

⇒ ∠OAB = 21°

**∴ The measure of ∠OAB is 21°.**
